{{translated title}} ---- [[File:Pokémon Frienda Teach Me Friender-Man.png|thumb|250px|Pokémon Frienda: Teach Me, Friender-Man!]] (Japanese: '''{{j|ポケモンフレンダ　おしえて！フレンダーマン}}''' ''Pokémon Frienda: Teach Me, Friender-Man!'') is a [[Pokémon manga]] by [[Kemon Kawamoto]]. It is serialized in the ''[[CoroCoro|CoroCoro Ichiban!]]'' magazine, with the first chapter published in the September 2024 issue, released on July 20, 2024. It is based on the arcade game [[Pokémon Frienda]]. It tells the story of Renda Tomoda and Friender-Man. ==Characters== * '''Renda Tomoda''' (Japanese: '''{{j|{{ruby|友|とも}}{{ruby|多|だ}}レンダ}}''' ''Tomoda Renda''). He debuted in [[OFM01]]. * '''Friender-Man''' (Japanese: '''{{j|フレンダーマン}}''' ''Friender-Man''). He debuted in [[OFM01]]. ===Gallery===
